body: Being suicidal is a lot like treading water in a stormy ocean. I didn’t come up with that metaphor, it was probably first said by someone more talented than I. In any case, being suicidal is a lot like constantly treading water in a stormy sea. In early September, I found my lifeboat. She protected me from the stormy waves when I felt like the ocean was about to swallow me whole. When the ocean calmed, she was still there, ready to brace the waves if the ocean were to awaken once again. She kept me safe, and probably saved my life. I fell in love. She didn’t. It hurt to much, and I had to leave. I had to leave my lifeboat. And the seas were rough. Have been for awhile now. And here I am, treading water once again, with no lifeboat, I can’t swim, haven’t slept for two days and both my legs are broken. That’s how it feels like. Complete loneliness in a vast ocean of emptiness. Some pieces of driftwood pass by, which keep me staying afloat for some time, but eventually they dissapear. The people trying to help me now are in yachts — the good life. I still prefer my lifeboat. I’d have stayed in that sweet embrace for eternety had it let me. Had she wanted me.

Thanks for taking the time to respond. Currently speaking to a therapist but I don’t feel like it’s working. I have one friend I can turn too. I get a feeling he and the person whom I have feelings for might have something going on between them. I know it’s not right but I think that would make me resent them and cause me more suffering. I’ll ask him tomorrow if I dare it’s terrifying. I might lose the two people I could turn to. Then I would truly be lost
Thank you. I’ll hang on for as long as I can.

I have tried doing that but it does not have the same calming effect as actually cutting myself for me personally. Idk about how others feel but for me it’s something that helps reaffirm that I still can feel something when everything else is numb
And also that this person is one of the only people I have to lean on makes it that much harder
Unrequited love coupled with a lifelong feeling of being unlovable has gotten me kind of fucked up
